prompt: Please generate an image. Locked painterly style: hand-painted stylized game art, chunky readable shapes, detail painted not modelled, mid-level detail, softer muted colours with gentle saturation, epic and luminous, never grim. The palette's warm gold and cool teal are painted into the surfaces, but the light is flat, even studio light: no strong key light, no cast shadows, no rim light. Use the attached images only as reference as described: the first attachment is always the style reference for palette and brushwork; later attachments are the approved designs to keep. Game-asset reference sheet for 3D modelling, wide landscape 16:9. Plain light neutral grey background, no scene, no sky, no clouds, no floating rock, no ground plane, a soft contact shadow only. Every piece fully isolated with clear space around it, nothing overlapping, nothing touching the edge, arranged in tidy rows, each with a small neat hand-lettered label underneath. MODULAR KIT PIECES sheet: Redraw of the attached reference sheet to the current spec: keep exactly the same pieces, their order, names and sizes. Roothold biome nature kit, 24 pieces, labels exactly as written in quotes, sizes as width x height. Row 1, TREES: "Ancient tree" 34 x 36 m (the landmark: huge twisted braided trunk, buttress roots, vast clumped yellow-green crown, drawn largest); "Oak" 14 x 15 m (short gnarled trunk, buttress roots, crown leaning to one side); "Elder, broad" 9 x 8 m (five or six grey-brown stems from one root boss, rounded canopy with cream blossom clusters); "Elder, slender" 6 x 8 m (three or four stems, open upright canopy with cream blossom); "Cedar, tall" 9 x 18 m (straight reddish fibrous trunk, flat tiers of dark blue-green foliage to a point); "Cedar, young" 5 x 12 m (narrower, fewer tiers). Row 2, UNDERSTORY: "Fern clump" 1.6 x 1.1 m; "Root arch" 4.5 x 2.8 m (one thick root looping out of the ground and back, high enough to walk under); "Fallen trunk" 6 x 1.5 m (hollow mossy oak trunk, small pale mushrooms); "Glowing mushroom cluster" 1.2 x 0.9 m (teal-capped mushrooms glowing on a moss pad); "Seedling sapling" 0.8 x 1.2 m (sapling with a few lime leaves on a moss tuft, thick stem); "Lichen stump" 1.6 x 1.4 m (cut stump, flared roots, lichen, moss cap). Row 3, GROUND COVER: "Deep moss clump" 1.4 x 0.4 m; "Leaf litter" 1.2 x 0.15 m; "Surface roots" 1.8 x 0.35 m; "Fern and moss tuft" 0.9 x 0.5 m. Row 4, ROCK AND ISLE EDGE: "Granite boulder, large" 2.2 x 1.6 m (rounded grey granite, lichen rosettes, moss cap); "Granite boulder, small" 1.6 x 1.1 m (blockier); "Slate slab" 2 x 0.6 m (two or three stacked blue-grey plates); "Quarried slate step block" 1.6 x 0.8 m (three cut steps softened by moss); "Mossy outcrop" 2.2 x 3.2 m (tall jagged stacked granite and slate, moss on every ledge); "Root-wrapped isle edge" 8 x 4 m (moss-and-turf top, grey granite face wrapped in thick roots spilling over, hanging moss, flat cut ends, no waterfall on it); "Spring waterfall" 1.2 x 6 m (thin pale ribbon of falling water with a small foam lip at the top, drawn alone as a chunky solid ribbon); "Root-wrapped underside taper" 8 x 10 m (inverted cone of grey granite wrapped in huge braided roots trailing below the tip, hanging moss, small teal glowing mushrooms in root pockets). Mossy greens, root browns and grey granite as in the attached sheet. Show each piece as an orthographic front elevation (no perspective) with a small three-quarter view beside it, on faint module grid lines, with its name and size (for example "3 x 4 m") in the label. Thick, solid forms, no thin parts. A plain neutral 1.8 m human silhouette labelled "1.8 m" stands on the sheet for scale, with everything at true scale to it. Title at the top: "Roothold nature kit".
